quests.instruction: Which old-fashioned airplane has two sets of wings stacked one above the other?
quests.hint: Think about an early kind of airplane with a wing on top and another wing below it.
quests.explanation: A biplane is an airplane with two sets of wings, one above the other. Early airplanes were often biplanes!
quests.funFact: Biplanes were some of the very first airplanes ever built, over a hundred years ago!

quests.instruction: Which airplane has no engine and floats silently on rising air?
quests.hint: Think about a quiet airplane with no engine, riding gently on the wind.
quests.explanation: A glider is an airplane with no engine that floats on rising air. Gliders fly silently through the sky!
quests.funFact: A glider can stay up in the air for hours by riding warm currents of rising air!

quests.instruction: Which airplane has floats instead of wheels so it can land right on water?
quests.hint: Think about an airplane that lands smoothly on a lake instead of a runway.
quests.explanation: A seaplane is an airplane with floats instead of wheels. Seaplanes can land and take off right on water!
quests.funFact: Seaplanes are perfect for reaching small islands that do not have a runway!

quests.instruction: Which airplane carries boxes and packages instead of passengers?
quests.hint: Think about a big airplane with no seats inside, just packed full of boxes.
quests.explanation: A cargo plane is an airplane that carries boxes and goods. Cargo planes have no passenger seats at all!
quests.funFact: A cargo plane can carry heavy packages across the world in just a matter of hours!

quests.instruction: Which small flying machine has no pilot inside and is flown using a remote control?
quests.hint: Think about a small flying gadget that buzzes overhead with nobody sitting inside it.
quests.explanation: A drone is a small flying machine with no pilot inside. Drones are flown using a remote control!
quests.funFact: Some drones are even used to safely deliver small packages to people's homes!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle launches like a rocket but glides back to Earth like an airplane?
quests.hint: Think about a space vehicle that blasts off like a rocket but lands smoothly on a runway.
quests.explanation: A space shuttle is a vehicle that launches like a rocket and lands like an airplane. It can be used again and again!
quests.funFact: A space shuttle was one of the first spacecraft that could be reused for many missions!

quests.instruction: Which soft, floating airship is shaped like a giant balloon and often shows advertisements?
quests.hint: Think about a big, soft, oval-shaped airship you might see floating above a sports stadium.
quests.explanation: A blimp is a soft airship filled with gas that floats gently. Blimps often fly above stadiums during big games!
quests.funFact: A blimp has no hard frame inside, so it stays soft and squishy like a giant balloon!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle floats just above the ground or water on a cushion of air?
quests.hint: Think about a vehicle that glides just above the surface, riding on a puffy cushion of air.
quests.explanation: A hovercraft is a vehicle that floats on a cushion of air. Hovercrafts can travel over both land and water!
quests.funFact: A hovercraft can glide smoothly over bumpy ground, water, or even ice!

quests.instruction: Which boat has two long hulls side by side instead of just one?
quests.hint: Think about a boat that looks like two thin boats joined together side by side.
quests.explanation: A catamaran is a boat with two hulls side by side. Two hulls help a catamaran stay very steady on the water!
quests.funFact: Catamarans are famous for being fast and very stable, even in choppy water!

quests.instruction: Which boat has rooms inside where a family can actually live?
quests.hint: Think about a boat built like a floating little house, with a kitchen and beds inside.
quests.explanation: A houseboat is a boat with rooms where a family can live. Houseboats float on rivers and calm lakes!
quests.funFact: Some people live on a houseboat all year round, just like a regular house!

quests.instruction: Which small, powerful boat pushes or pulls much bigger ships into harbor?
quests.hint: Think about a small but very strong boat that helps guide giant ships safely into port.
quests.explanation: A tugboat is a small, powerful boat that pushes or pulls bigger ships. Tugboats guide huge ships safely into harbor!
quests.funFact: A tugboat is much smaller than the ships it pulls, but its engine is incredibly powerful!

quests.instruction: Which boat do people use to catch fish out on the open water?
quests.hint: Think about a boat loaded with nets and rods, heading out early to catch fish.
quests.explanation: A fishing boat is a boat used to catch fish. Fishing boats carry nets and equipment out on the water!
quests.funFact: Fishing boats often head out very early in the morning to catch the freshest fish!

quests.instruction: Which simple, flat floating vehicle is made of logs or tubes tied together?
quests.hint: Think about a simple, flat floating vehicle you might use to cross a calm river.
quests.explanation: A raft is a simple, flat floating vehicle made of logs or tubes. Rafts float people gently down a river!
quests.funFact: Long ago, people built the very first rafts by tying logs together with rope!

quests.instruction: Which long, flat boat carries heavy cargo slowly along a river or canal?
quests.hint: Think about a long, flat, slow-moving boat piled high with heavy cargo on a canal.
quests.explanation: A barge is a long, flat boat that carries heavy cargo. Barges move slowly along rivers and canals!
quests.funFact: A single barge can carry as much cargo as dozens of trucks all at once!

quests.instruction: Which long train carries goods and cargo instead of passengers?
quests.hint: Think about a very long train stacked with containers instead of rows of seats.
quests.explanation: A freight train is a train that carries goods instead of passengers. Freight trains can be incredibly long!
quests.funFact: A freight train can be over one hundred cars long, pulled by a single powerful engine!

quests.instruction: Which train is built with rows of comfortable seats to carry people?
quests.hint: Think about the kind of train you would ride to visit family in another city.
quests.explanation: A passenger train is a train built to carry people. Passenger trains have comfortable seats for every rider!
quests.funFact: Passenger trains often have a dining car where travelers can enjoy a meal on board!

quests.instruction: Which super-fast train has a pointed nose and zooms between cities in minutes?
quests.hint: Think about an incredibly fast train with a sleek, pointed front, built for speed.
quests.explanation: A bullet train is a super-fast train with a pointed nose. Bullet trains can travel faster than three hundred kilometers per hour!
quests.funFact: A bullet train gets its pointed nose shape to help it slice through the air quickly!

quests.instruction: Which old-fashioned train puffs clouds of smoke as it chugs along the tracks?
quests.hint: Think about a classic old train that puffs white smoke and makes a loud chugging sound.
quests.explanation: A steam train is an old-fashioned train powered by burning coal to make steam. Steam trains puff smoke as they chug along!
quests.funFact: A steam train's whistle can be heard from far away, warning others it is coming!

quests.instruction: Which giant ship carries huge stacks of shipping containers across the ocean?
quests.hint: Think about an enormous ship piled high with colorful metal shipping containers.
quests.explanation: A cargo ship is a giant ship that carries shipping containers. Cargo ships carry goods across the whole ocean!
quests.funFact: A single cargo ship can carry thousands of shipping containers at the very same time!

quests.instruction: Which giant ship carries huge amounts of oil or liquid across the sea?
quests.hint: Think about a massive ship built with tanks inside to hold liquid instead of boxes.
quests.explanation: A tanker is a giant ship that carries liquid, like oil. Tankers have huge tanks built inside their hull!
quests.funFact: Tankers are some of the largest moving vehicles ever built by people!

quests.instruction: Which ship is stacked high with rectangular metal boxes used to carry goods around the world?
quests.hint: Think about a ship whose deck is completely covered in colorful, stacked metal boxes.
quests.explanation: A container ship is a ship stacked with metal boxes called containers. Container ships carry goods all around the world!
quests.funFact: Each metal container on a container ship is the exact same size, so they stack together perfectly!

quests.instruction: Which small, light vehicle is pulled or pedaled by a person to carry one or two passengers?
quests.hint: Think about a small cart with a seat, either pulled by a runner or pedaled like a bicycle.
quests.explanation: A rickshaw is a small vehicle pulled or pedaled by a person. Rickshaws carry one or two passengers at a time!
quests.funFact: Rickshaws are still a popular way to travel short distances in many busy cities today!

quests.instruction: Which ancient, open, wheeled vehicle was pulled by horses in old stories and races?
quests.hint: Think about an ancient two-wheeled vehicle a hero might stand in, pulled by galloping horses.
quests.explanation: A chariot is an ancient, open, wheeled vehicle pulled by horses. Chariots were used long ago in races and travel!
quests.funFact: Chariot races were one of the most exciting events in ancient times!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle glides over snow, often pulled by horses or reindeer?
quests.hint: Think about a fancy sled with seats, pulled along the snow by animals instead of an engine.
quests.explanation: A sleigh is a vehicle that glides over snow, often pulled by animals. Sleighs have seats and smooth runners!
quests.funFact: Sleighs were once a common way for whole families to travel across snowy winter roads!

quests.instruction: Which old-fashioned covered carriage was pulled by several horses to carry mail and passengers far away?
quests.hint: Think about a covered wooden carriage pulled by a team of horses, traveling between towns long ago.
quests.explanation: A stagecoach is a covered carriage pulled by horses. Stagecoaches once carried mail and passengers between towns!
quests.funFact: A stagecoach journey between two towns could once take many long days to complete!

quests.instruction: Which small cart has just one wheel in front and two handles you push from behind?
quests.hint: Think about a simple one-wheeled cart a gardener pushes to carry dirt or leaves.
quests.explanation: A wheelbarrow is a small cart with one wheel and two handles. We push a wheelbarrow to carry dirt or leaves!
quests.funFact: Having just one wheel makes a wheelbarrow easy to steer, even on bumpy ground!

quests.instruction: Which small extra seat attaches to the side of a motorcycle for a passenger?
quests.hint: Think about a little seat with its own wheel, attached right next to a motorcycle.
quests.explanation: A sidecar is a small seat that attaches to a motorcycle. A passenger can ride safely inside a sidecar!
quests.funFact: A sidecar has its own small wheel to help keep the whole motorcycle balanced!

quests.instruction: Which van has no back seats or windows, only empty space for carrying boxes?
quests.hint: Think about a box-shaped van with no windows in the back, built just for carrying deliveries.
quests.explanation: A cargo van is a van with no back seats, only space for boxes. Cargo vans carry deliveries around town!
quests.funFact: A cargo van's empty back space can be packed full of boxes for a whole day of deliveries!

quests.instruction: Which big truck carries furniture and boxes when a family moves to a new home?
quests.hint: Think about a huge truck loaded with couches, beds, and boxes on a busy moving day.
quests.explanation: A moving truck is a big truck that carries furniture. Moving trucks help families move all their things to a new home!
quests.funFact: A moving truck's tall, wide space can fit an entire home's worth of furniture!

quests.instruction: Which truck has a little kitchen inside and serves tasty meals from a street window?
quests.hint: Think about a colorful truck parked on the street, serving hot food through a little window.
quests.explanation: A food truck is a truck with a kitchen inside. Food trucks serve tasty meals right from a street window!
quests.funFact: Food trucks can park in a new spot every day to serve food in different neighborhoods!
